name: Atmos-Machine-Tiers
title: Atmos Machine Tiers
author: Atom735
description: Adds upgrade tiers for assemblers, chemical plants, refineries, furnaces, mining drills, pumpjacks, offshore pumps and other production machines: craft 5 of the previous tier into 1 of the next. Each tier adds speed, a module slot and energy use. Original graphics with a tier badge. Many settings.
